categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Sitemap and robots.txt correct and on the right host
is_spa false — all primary copy server-rendered
All AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot) receive 200

findings.title: Duplicate domain served without a 301
findings.description: www.meghrajgiri.com.np returns HTTP 200 with full duplicate content and only a cross-domain canonical. A live search for '"Meghraj Giri" developer Nepal' returns the .com.np URL with a stale title and description.
findings.recommendation: Set a permanent redirect to www.meghrajgiri.com at the Vercel domain level, then run Change of Address in Search Console. Weigh first: every ranking Nepali competitor uses a .com.np ccTLD.

findings.title: Security headers missing
findings.description: No X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Content-Security-Policy or Permissions-Policy. x-powered-by: Next.js exposed.
findings.recommendation: Add headers in next.config.ts; disable poweredByHeader.

findings.title: No indexable About or Contact URL
findings.description: About and Contact exist only as same-page anchors, so neither can rank or be cited independently.
findings.recommendation: Create /about as the entity anchor page.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Two project pages carry real metrics (Yume acquisition, College Cost Secrets)

findings.title: Live unfilled template placeholders on a project page
findings.description: /projects/cannabiz-elite renders 8 placeholder blocks including '[N] Clinics onboarded', '[specific constraint]', '[The retrospective...]' and 'Pending clearance'. Also present in production JSON-LD CreativeWork.abstract. Only page affected of 9 checked.
findings.recommendation: Finish the case study with real figures or unpublish the page. Add a build guard rejecting [bracket] patterns.

findings.title: Experience and education content never renders
findings.description: config.experience (5 named employers with dates) and config.education (BSc CSIT, IOST/Tribhuvan University) are fully populated with working CMS editors, but no public component consumes them. Only consumer is AboutSection.tsx:20 reading .length to print '5'.
findings.recommendation: Build the Journey and Education sections. Highest return per hour in the audit — the copy already exists.

findings.title: Thin content across all pages
findings.description: Homepage 502 words (headless render: 2,565 chars extracted). Project pages 109-377 words. SEO-STRATEGY.md's '~2,500 words' figure counted script payload and is wrong.
findings.recommendation: Convert project pages into metric-bearing case studies using the resume figures.

findings.title: Unsupported numeric claims
findings.description: '20+ Products Shipped' against 7 displayed projects; '5 roles · 2 qualifications' with neither shown.
findings.recommendation: Show the evidence or reconcile the numbers.

findings.title: Incorrect regulatory framework cited
findings.description: SCSS Consulting entry claims 'HIPAA compliance and Australian health policies'; Cannabiz Elite tags 'HIPAA compliance'. HIPAA is US law and does not apply to Australian clinics.
findings.recommendation: Replace with Privacy Act and AHPRA.

findings.title: Dead navigation anchors
findings.description: Nav links 'Services' (#expertise) and 'Journey' (#journey) target IDs absent from the DOM. Two of five nav items broken site-wide.
findings.recommendation: Ship the sections or remove the links.

findings.title: No location signal in title, description or H1
findings.description: H1 is 'Building products people love to use'. Neither title nor meta description mentions Nepal or Butwal.
findings.recommendation: Add Nepal to the title and description; rewrite the H1 to carry role and location.

findings.title: Testimonials render nothing
findings.description: TestimonialsSection is mounted in the RSC tree but outputs no testimonial text.
findings.recommendation: Populate or remove.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD, single @graph per page, stable @id references — a good pattern worth keeping

findings.title: Placeholder text emitted in production JSON-LD
findings.description: CreativeWork.abstract on /projects/cannabiz-elite carries the unfilled template text verbatim.
findings.recommendation: Fix the source content and guard the builder.

findings.title: addressLocality holds a country
findings.description: Person.address.addressLocality is 'Nepal'. Nepal is a country, not a locality, and this discards Butwal — the one fact that disambiguates him.
findings.recommendation: Set addressLocality to Butwal with addressRegion Lumbini Province and addressCountry NP.

findings.title: Person node missing every disambiguating property
findings.description: No image, description, alumniOf, worksFor, hasCredential, hasOccupation, nationality, homeLocation or knowsLanguage. sameAs omits the Toptal profile. knowsAbout lists 27 skills, beyond what shipped work evidences.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild per findings/schema.md; trim knowsAbout to ~14.

findings.title: /projects drops the Person node
findings.description: Emits BreadcrumbList and ItemList but no Person reference, breaking the entity graph on that page.
findings.recommendation: Add the Person reference; wrap ItemList in CollectionPage.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Statically prerendered and served from Vercel edge cache
Self-hosted fonts via next/font/local with preload

findings.title: LCP preload targets the wrong URL
findings.description: layout.tsx preloads /Meghraj.jpg (149KB raw) but the rendered img requests /_next/image?url=%2FMeghraj.jpg&w=... The preload downloads a file the browser never uses and fails to preload the real LCP resource.
findings.recommendation: Preload the optimised _next/image URL, or drop the preload and set priority on the Image component.

findings.title: Unoptimised logo
findings.description: /logo.png is a 211KB PNG.
findings.recommendation: Compress and convert to WebP.

findings.title: No field data available
findings.description: Keyless PageSpeed Insights quota exhausted; CrUX needs an API key. All performance commentary is structural, not measured.
findings.recommendation: Add a Google API key.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Content is server-rendered, so no JS-execution barrier for crawlers

findings.title: Entity unresolvable
findings.description: Brand search returns six unrelated Giri/Meghraj Wikipedia entities plus an unrelated Behance profile. No knowledge panel. Toptal profile does not surface. An AI Overview will not name a person it cannot disambiguate.
findings.recommendation: Execute the Phase 3 entity work, then Phase 4 barnacle placement.

findings.title: Absent from the corpora AI answers are built from
findings.description: 'Top developers in Nepal' answers are synthesised from Clutch, GoodFirms, TechBehemoths, Twine, Upwork, Truelancer and Nepali listicles. He appears on none of them.
findings.recommendation: Work the Phase 4 barnacle list.

findings.title: Low passage citability
findings.description: Marketing copy such as 'Building products people love to use' and 'that's where real magic happens' is unquotable — no entity, attribute or evidence.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite key passages as self-contained claims carrying name, location, credential and a number.

findings.title: llms.txt absent
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Not recommended. Google Search ignores it; the real bottleneck is content that never renders.

categories.name: Images
what_works: next/image with responsive srcSet and correct sizes

findings.title: Oversized source assets
findings.description: /logo.png 211KB, /Meghraj.jpg 149KB raw.
findings.recommendation: Compress; serve WebP/AVIF.
